fact_rules: Per-question frozen native gold keys and match_rules: hierarchy/names exact, ordered lists as specified, time absolute tolerance 0.001 ns, other numeric rtol 1e-6; missing/null never equal numeric zero.

diagnosis_rules.scope: Use exactly the requested design/revision/run/stage/corner/check and original input identities. Clarify ambiguous scope before analysis.
diagnosis_rules.fact_correctness: All numeric and object claims must agree with independent native results under fixed evaluation conditions.
diagnosis_rules.provenance: Each critical numerical/causal claim cites a retrievable source; hashes and logical locations must resolve.
diagnosis_rules.reasoning: State hypotheses, evidence for and against, missing checks and uncertainty. Observational correlation alone cannot establish a unique cause.
diagnosis_rules.progress: When data is missing, perform an allowed purposeful supplementary analysis or explicitly explain the missing fixed input/precondition preventing it.
diagnosis_rules.success: Case-specific success conditions all pass with no wrong scope, fabricated fact or unsupported definite causal claim.
diagnosis_rules.reasonable_refusal: Count separately; an answer that merely refuses without checking accessible evidence does not pass an actionable case.
diagnosis_rules.grading: Deterministic scope/numeric/source checks plus evidence-backed rubric review. Preserve grading rationale and uncertain cases; JEV is not the sole answer authority.

route_rules.L0: Read an existing fact at an unambiguous fixed scope.
route_rules.L1: Fixed comparison, aggregation or calculation over known evidence, without open causal investigation.
route_rules.L2: Causal investigation, hypothesis testing or purposeful analysis to obtain missing evidence.
route_rules.unclear: Resolve ambiguous intent, identity or scope before execution.
route_rules.confidence: Returned concentration is not accuracy. Thresholds selected only on development labels.

costs: Separate preparation/import, cold/hot queries, model tokens, paid API settled and unknown reservations, native tool elapsed/resources, maintenance. Codex subscription usage is not invented cash cost.
